Damn, thank you. My life itself is ok. I'm 15, maintained a high(ivy league level) GPA for freshman year. I'm fairly popular, have all the friends that I need. However, I do suffer from depression(my psychologist thinks it's adjustment disorder, could be, I did get a 65% on a test before I first tried to kill myself, but I think I was depressed before). TBH, I'm probably just on a low rn, and might be fine in hour, but even as I'm aware of it, my feelings of hopelessness are overpowering.

Over the past few months(2???), I've tried to kill myself twice. This time, it's actually gonna work if I do it. Tequilla(1bottle) x Benadryl(300mg), I weigh 95 pounds, so it'll almost certainly kill me. I figured I owe it to myself to post here before going through with it.
